text: Larry Talbot returns to his ancestral home in Llanwelly, Wales, and buys a walking stick topped with [a silver wolf's head|rules|it has a fatal weakness] to court Gwen, who runs the antique shop. Walking out one night, he kills a wolf attacking her friend Jenny but is [bitten on the chest|origin|caught from another], and the wound heals overnight. Soon he [turns into a humanoid wolf|threat|the body turning monstrous] when the moon rises, wakes with no memory, and sees a pentagram on [the palm of the woman he loves|who_suffers|objects of desire].
